sites.functional_impact_measured: Subcellular localization determined by anti-HA antibody staining (Alexa Fluor 488 secondary); protein expression verified. No functional assay (ligand binding, cAMP) reported in the cited clips.
sites.rationale: PTGER3 is a Class A GPCR with no signal peptide; the topology landmarks place residues 1–53 extracellular and TM1 beginning at residue 54. The ledger phrase 'before the EP3 common region' designates the shared N-terminal/TM portion common to all EP3 isoforms, so the tag is prepended before residue 1 (insert_after_residue = 0). This is the sole extracellular terminus of the protein, making the position topology_derived. The prepend site is 53 residues from the TM1 boundary, well within the ≥3-residue clearance requirement. Full-length EP3 receptor isoforms were HA-tagged and expressed in CHO cells (PMC3832896). The tag was inserted 'before the EP3 common region' of each isoform using QuikChange site-directed mutagenesis; constructs were used to verify expression and determine subcellular localization by anti-HA immunofluorescence.

sources.claim: The hemagglutinin (HA) tag was inserted before the EP3 common region of each isoform using the QuikChange site-directed mutagenesis kit (Stratagene, La Jolla, CA).

literature_notes: All three ledger lines (L1, L2, L3) describe the same HA-tagging experiment from PMC3832896; L1 is the primary evidence for the construct design, L2/L3 for the expression/localization readout. No residue number is named in any clip, but PTGER3 has exactly one extracellular terminus (N-terminus, residues 1–53, no signal peptide), so the position is unambiguously topology_derived as a prepend (insert_after_residue = 0). The three other extracellular regions (ECL1 113–131, ECL2 198–227, ECL3 308–327) have no ledger support and are not proposed. Validation is surface_only because the clips report subcellular localization by immunofluorescence but cite no functional assay.
